description: Inspect and grease. Kawasaki: first at 25 hr, then every 50 hr; service before long storage. Yamaha: check bearing grease condition.
source: Kawasaki Ultra 310 manual (p.30, as summarized); Yamaha VX chart
notes: Source: Kawasaki Ultra 310 manual (p.30, as summarized); Yamaha VX chart.

title: Intake grate, ride plate & pump housing
description: Inspect and clean. Clear debris after each ride.

title: Battery
description: Test. Keep on a maintainer in storage.

notes: Severe service: Saltwater: monthly (Sea-Doo). Source: BRP Sea-Doo shop manual summary.

title: Hull bottom, sponsons, bond line, bilge & drain plugs
description: Inspect and clean. Full inspection yearly.

notes: Source: USCG fire extinguisher FAQ (uscgboating.org); Oregon State Marine Board.

notes: Source: USCG Boater's Guide; West Marine.

title: Registration / documentation renewal
description: Renew. Renewal cycles vary by state (1-3 yr).
notes: Defaults to yearly; change it to your state's renewal cycle. Source: General practice.

title: Pre-ride check
description: Inspect. Drain plugs in, intake clear, fuel and oil level, battery, steering and throttle, kill switch, safety gear.

title: Winterization
description: Flush, fog, stabilize fuel, change oil. Yamaha/Kawasaki open loop: drain and blow out. Sea-Doo closed loop: verify antifreeze.

title: Spring commissioning
description: Inspect and test. Battery, hoses and clamps, pump and intake, safety-gear dates, kill switch test.
